Expected module names below come from public S2 sources (VideoLAN wiki + official release notes), which are community-maintained and not version-pinned to 3.0.23 — each is [VERIFY] until the hardware dump exists.

expected_platform_specific_modules.name: dshow
expected_platform_specific_modules.source: https://wiki.videolan.org/Documentation:Modules/dshow/ (page infobox: Type 'Access demux', OS 'Windows'; last modified 2019-03-23; accessed 2026-10-19)
expected_platform_specific_modules.note: Windows capture counterpart of Linux v4l2 (16 access_demux + access registrations in the Linux census).

expected_platform_specific_modules.name: mmdevice
expected_platform_specific_modules.source: https://wiki.videolan.org/Documentation:Modules/mmdevice/ (Type 'Audio output', OS 'Windows', first VLC 2.0; accessed 2026-10-19); corroborated by official 3.0.0 release notes 'HDMI/SPDIF pass-through support for WASAPI' https://www.videolan.org/vlc/releases/3.0.0.html (accessed 2026-10-19)
expected_platform_specific_modules.note: Counterpart of Linux alsa/pulse audio outputs.

expected_platform_specific_modules.name: directsound (wiki page 'directx_aout')
expected_platform_specific_modules.note: Legacy fallback audio output; presence in 3.0.23 win64 build [VERIFY].

expected_platform_specific_modules.name: direct3d11
expected_platform_specific_modules.description: Direct3D 11 video output (desktop + WinRT modes; HDR10 support)
expected_platform_specific_modules.source: Official 3.0.0 release notes: 'New Direct3D11 video output supporting both Windows desktop and WinRT modes' and 'HDR10 support in Direct3D11 with Windows 10 Fall Creator Update' — https://www.videolan.org/vlc/releases/3.0.0.html (accessed 2026-10-19)
expected_platform_specific_modules.note: No wiki page exists for direct3d11; module name/split in 3.0.23 [VERIFY].

expected_platform_specific_modules.name: glwin32
expected_platform_specific_modules.description: OpenGL video output for Windows (shortcuts glwin32, opengl)
expected_platform_specific_modules.note: Counterpart of Linux gl/glx/egl vout family.

expected_platform_specific_modules.name: smb
expected_platform_specific_modules.source: Official 3.0.0 release notes: 'Network browsing for distant filesystems (SMB, FTP, SFTP, NFS...)' — https://www.videolan.org/vlc/releases/3.0.0.html (accessed 2026-10-19). The wiki module page Documentation:Modules/smb no longer exists (checked 2026-10-19).
expected_platform_specific_modules.note: On the Linux census SMB is MISSING only because Debian ships it in vlc-plugin-samba, one of the 10 headless-excluded packages (scope limitation, see modules-summary.md §6) — expected a packaging diff, not a platform diff.

expected_platform_specific_modules.name: screen (windows variant)
expected_platform_specific_modules.description: Screen capture (wiki lists OS 'all'; Linux census instead has xcb_apps services_discovery 'Screen capture')
expected_platform_specific_modules.note: Expected diff vs Linux census: Windows screen capture is an access module, Linux headless exposes it as a services_discovery entry.

expected_platform_specific_modules.name: dxva2 / d3d11va (DirectX Video Acceleration)
expected_platform_specific_modules.source: Official 3.0.0 release notes: 'VLC 3.0 activates hardware decoding by default' — https://www.videolan.org/vlc/releases/3.0.0.html (accessed 2026-10-19); whether 3.0.23 win64 exposes separate hw-decoder modules or avcodec-only [VERIFY]
expected_platform_specific_modules.note: Counterpart of Linux vaapi/vaapi_drm/vdpau_avcodec (hw decoder capability) + avcodec ffmpeghw registration (score 10001 in the Linux census).

v4l2, dvb, dtv, access_demux capture family — Linux-only capture (dshow covers Windows capture)
xcb_* vouts and vout windows (xcb_x11, xcb_xv, xcb_window), wl_shm/wl_shell/xdg_shell (Wayland), fb, aa/caca console outputs, flaschen
vaapi*, vdpau*, glconv_vaapi_*, glconv_vdpau — replaced by DirectX VA equivalents
udev services_discovery (Linux device monitoring); avahi/dbus/pulselist SD entries

skins2 interface [VERIFY still shipped in 3.0.23 win64]
